description:
Add slide numbers, a footer, and a fixed date to an existing presentation. Open '/home/ga/Documents/Presentations/q4_operations_review.odp'. Use the 'Insert > Header and Footer' dialog to configure the following settings: 
1. Enable 'Date and time', set it to 'Fixed', and enter today's date (e.g., '2024-12-15').
2. Enable 'Slide number'.
3. Enable 'Footer' and enter the text: 'Operations Division - Confidential'.
4. Check 'Do not show on first slide'.
5. Click 'Apply to All' to apply these settings to slides 2-6.
6. Save the file.
